name: Migrate Legacy Codebase
description: Orchestrates the systematic modernization of a legacy codebase by chaining four engineering skills into a structured migration pipeline. Covers technical debt assessment, incremental refactoring, integration testing, and safe deployment of modernized components. Use when the user needs to modernize a legacy system incrementally without breaking existing functionality. Do NOT use for greenfield rewrites, simple library upgrades, or projects where the legacy system can be replaced entirely.
